skill.description: 装修建材选购专用 Skill。覆盖瓷砖、木地板、涂料乳胶漆、板材、门窗玻璃、五金管件、防水材料、美缝填缝、石材岩板、踢脚线等主材辅材的选购避坑，整合西安装修课堂装修知识库精华，帮用户把钱花在刀刃上，材料不踩坑。
skill.summary: Compare renovation materials, review purchasing risks, and prepare practical checklists using 180 Chinese reference articles.
skill.author: zx029w

content.user_title: Choose Renovation Materials With Practical Checklists
content.value_statement: Renovation buyers must compare unfamiliar materials, installation requirements, and confusing supplier claims. This skill organizes Chinese renovation references into material comparisons, purchasing questions, and practical checklists.
actual_capabilities: Compare tiles, wood flooring, wall finishes, cabinet boards, windows, and waterproofing materials using topic-indexed references.
Adapt material recommendations to room use, household needs, heating conditions, humidity, and budget.
Explain purchasing risks involving product specifications, tile quantities, installation charges, and supplier claims.
Prepare self-check lists for slip resistance, child safety, and renovation coordination.
Explain installation sequencing for flooring, doors, painting, grouting, and related finishing work.
Summarize regional renovation cost references while distinguishing estimates from formal quotations.
limitations: References are primarily Chinese and often reflect Xi'an or northern Chinese renovation practices.
Prices are static regional examples, not live supplier quotations or guaranteed project costs.
Some references contain broad or conflicting health and material claims that require independent verification.
The skill cannot inspect a property, certify products, approve structural changes, or replace qualified construction professionals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Renovation Purchase List
use_cases.description: Compare flooring and wall finishes against household needs, then prepare supplier questions and a room-specific shopping checklist.

use_cases.title: Explain Material Tradeoffs to Clients
use_cases.description: Organize material options by appearance, maintenance, humidity, and installation constraints for a client discussion.

use_cases.title: Review Material and Installation Quotes
use_cases.description: Identify missing specifications, quantity assumptions, exclusions, and sequencing questions before agreeing to a renovation purchase.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Flooring Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare tiles and wood flooring for my [room] in [city]. My budget is [amount], and my home has [heating type]. Explain tradeoffs and questions to ask before buying.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Room Shopping Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a material shopping checklist for a [room type] used by [household members]. Consider [humidity], [budget], and [maintenance preferences]. Include specifications to confirm and safety questions for an installer.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Supplier Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this anonymized material and installation quote: [quote]. Identify missing product models, quantity assumptions, exclusions, and possible additional charges. Cite relevant references and separate regional examples from current local prices.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Material Selection Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan materials for [rooms] within [budget] in [city], considering [heating], [humidity], and [household needs]. Compare alternatives, outline installation dependencies, and prepare acceptance questions. Cite references, identify conflicting advice, and mark decisions requiring professional approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple rooms and trades.

output_examples.input: Compare wood-look tiles and wood flooring for a heated living room used by a family with a young child.
output: Wood-look tiles offer moisture resistance and lower maintenance, but feel harder underfoot.
Wood flooring offers a warmer feel, but requires product-specific checks for heating compatibility and moisture limits.
Ask suppliers for product test reports, installation requirements, and total costs including preparation, cutting, and grout.
Check slip resistance and finished floor levels with the installer.
Do not treat a material category or lack of odor as proof of indoor air safety.

output_examples.input: What should I check before accepting a tile supply and installation quote?
output: Confirm the tile model, dimensions, finish, batch, unit price, and room-specific quantities.
Request a layout plan and clarify cutting losses, spare tiles, and returns.
List adhesive, grout, leveling, edge finishing, delivery, and labor charges separately.
Agree on inspection criteria and responsibility for damaged tiles or installation defects.
Treat regional reference prices as comparison points, not binding quotations.

best_practices: Provide your city, room use, heating type, household needs, dimensions, and budget before requesting recommendations.
Ask for reference citations and distinguish source opinions from product specifications, test reports, and current local requirements.
Confirm quantities, installation compatibility, safety requirements, and written prices with qualified professionals before purchasing.
anti_patterns: Treating regional price examples as guaranteed quotations for another location or date.
Using material names, brand reputation, or odor alone to establish health or environmental safety.
Starting structural, electrical, or waterproofing work solely from generated advice without professional assessment.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers renovation material selection, purchasing risks, installation coordination, and related checks through 180 Chinese reference articles.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists all three tools as supported. The package contains Markdown instructions and references, without bundled executable scripts.

faq.question: Are its prices current and valid everywhere?
faq.answer: No. Prices are regional reference examples, mainly for Xi'an. Confirm current local costs and obtain written supplier quotations.

faq.question: Can it prove that a material is safe or low-emission?
faq.answer: No. It cannot test products or indoor air. Verify product-specific reports and consult qualified professionals about health or environmental concerns.

faq.question: Is the reference material available in English?
faq.answer: The bundled references are primarily Chinese. You can request an English explanation, but translated technical terms should be checked.

faq.question: Does it purchase materials or arrange contractors?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and checklists. It does not include purchasing, payment, booking, or live supplier integrations.
